title: Agentic AI & the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
subtitle: Building, Securing, and Orchestrating Production AI Agents with MCP
description: This course teaches learners to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents using leading provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, OpenRouter), code-first agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI), custom API-backed command-line tools, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for standardized tool and context integration. Learners implement agent-native CLIs with structured output, configuration checks, API authentication, and compound commands before exposing the same capabilities through MCP, then add multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, agent evaluation, observability, and guardrails. The course culminates in a capstone deploying a secure, observable, multi-agent system with both CLI and MCP-facing tool surfaces.
objectives: Build agents that call multiple LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter) with cost, latency, and observability instrumentation
Implement core agent patterns including tool calling, ReAct, planning, and memory/state management from first principles
Construct production agents using code-first frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Pydantic AI
Build API-backed, agent-native CLI tools and expose selected capabilities through MCP servers with proper authentication and security controls
Orchestrate multi-agent systems with handoffs, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and evaluate agent performance using observability tooling
slos: Build and instrument agents that call OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, Vertex, and OpenRouter for cost, latency, and reliability.
Implement tool calling, ReAct, planning, and memory/state management from first principles.
Construct production agents with LangGraph, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and Pydantic AI.
Build API-backed, agent-native CLI tools and expose selected capabilities through secure MCP servers.
Orchestrate multi-agent systems with handoffs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints, evaluated with observability tooling.

weeks.title: Agentic AI Foundations and the Provider Landscape
weeks.summary: Introduces agentic AI concepts and surveys the provider landscape (OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter) that agents will call.

weeks.title: Tool Calling, ReAct, and Agent Planning Patterns
weeks.summary: Covers core agent patterns including tool calling, the ReAct loop, and planning strategies from first principles.

weeks.title: Memory and State Management for Agents
weeks.summary: Covers memory and state management techniques that let agents retain context across multi-step interactions.

weeks.title: OpenAI, Claude, and Multi-Provider API Integration
weeks.summary: Covers integrating OpenAI and Anthropic Claude APIs into agents alongside multi-provider integration patterns.

weeks.title: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and OpenRouter Routing
weeks.summary: Covers integrating AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI and routing requests through OpenRouter.

weeks.title: Cost, Latency, and Observability Instrumentation
weeks.summary: Covers instrumenting agent calls for cost, latency, and observability across providers.

weeks.title: Code-First Agent Frameworks I: LangGraph and Pydantic AI
weeks.summary: Introduces building production agents with the code-first LangGraph and Pydantic AI frameworks.

weeks.title: Code-First Agent Frameworks II: CrewAI and OpenAI Agents SDK
weeks.summary: Midterm week: covers CrewAI and the OpenAI Agents SDK alongside the course midterm assessment.

weeks.title: MCP Architecture Deep Dive
weeks.summary: Provides a deep dive into Model Context Protocol architecture for standardized tool and context integration.

weeks.title: Building Agent-Native CLI Tools and MCP Servers
weeks.summary: Students map a real API into a reliable CLI with doctor checks, structured output, and compound commands, then expose selected capabilities through MCP.

weeks.title: MCP Authentication and Tool/Agent Security
weeks.summary: Covers MCP authentication mechanisms and security controls for tools and agents.

weeks.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration and Handoffs
weeks.summary: Covers orchestrating multi-agent systems, including handoffs between cooperating agents.

weeks.title: Human-in-the-Loop Workflows and Emerging Standards (A2A, AGENTS.md)
weeks.summary: Covers human-in-the-loop checkpoints alongside emerging agent standards such as A2A and AGENTS.md.

weeks.title: Agent Evaluation and Observability
weeks.summary: Covers evaluating agent performance and instrumenting agents with observability tooling.

weeks.title: Agent Deployment and Guardrails Introduction
weeks.summary: Covers deploying agents to production and introduces guardrails for safe agent behavior.

weeks.title: Capstone Project & Course Review
weeks.summary: Final capstone week: students deploy a secure, observable, multi-agent MCP-based system and review the course.
